title: Monitoring Specialist
description:
About Playtech

Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience.

As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: and
Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices.

Ready to level up your career?

Playtech Managed Services Sao Paulo is looking for a proactive Monitoring Specialist with excellent communication, attention to detail, reaction time and problem-solving skills. Job Description

Your influential mission. You will...

  • Perform Monitoring, Incident Management, Redundancy and Incident Reporting activities.
  • Work on shifts (16/7 coverage ).
  • Monitor multiple business systems and detect incidents across multiple service dependencies.
  • React by executing appropriate redundancy protocols based on service type.
  • Coordinate incident communication with multiple parties.
  • Familiarize yourself with Incident Management documentation.
  • Learn the company products at a technical and operational level, including backend settings, integrations and monitoring dashboards.
  • Liase with third parties during Incident Management.
  • Understand how the environments and available configurations work.
  • Acquire insight into Incident Management processes in a global company.
  • Communicate daily with other teams in and outside the company.
  • Constantly develop skills and get new knowledge in the Incident Management domain.
  • Carry out investigations to determine Incident root causes.
Qualifications

Components for success. You...

  • Are willing to develop your career in Incident Management.
  • You have previous experience in Monitoring, Incident Management or a similar role (1 year minimum, 2 or more years recommended).
  • Possess knowledge of Monitoring and Incident Reporting methodologies and processes.
  • Have strong command of English for both written and spoken communication, ensuring clear and professional interaction with internal teams, clients, and external stakeholders.

You'll get extra points for...

  • Having experience working with Grafana or similar tools
Additional Information

Thrive in a culture that values...

  • A supportive and collaborative team environment.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A commitment to innovation and excellence.
  • A diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is welcome.
  • Comprehensive benefits and competitive compensation.

HOW TO APPLY?

In addition to your CV, please add a brief motivation letter covering your goals, your current experience in Monitoring or related fields, and/or working in a corporate environment. You can write it in the comment section at the end of the application page (under "your message to the hiring manager").

Kindly provide your resume in English.

MONITORING TEAM

The Monitoring Team is a crucial part of the Incident Report Operational Center (IROC). The team is dedicated to centralizing incident monitoring, detection, and initial response across all relevant systems. Our mission is to ensure business continuity and protect customer experience by proactively managing incidents. The team monitors all business systems, detects incidents across multiple service dependencies, and reacts by executing appropriate redundancy protocols based on service type. We manage incident communication and documentation across all service types and criticality levels.

Our team operates 16/7, ensuring immediate response and detailed incident reporting, documenting all actions and outcomes for transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in incident management.

Join the team at our new Brazilian Playtech Managed Services (PTMS) office, where we work together to support and enhance our live products and services. Be part of a global, dynamic and innovative team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and excellence.

Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.

API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

o gestão do tempo de projetos e de prioridades em contexto educacional;

o comunicação institucional, oratória e condução de reuniões;

title: Cofundador
description:
Estamos construindo algo grande.E buscamos co-founders para fazer parte disso.

A Ommed nasceu para resolver um dos maiores problemas da humanidade: um sistema de saúde fragmentado e distante de cada pessoa.

Location & Administrative Maintenance:

- Development of MxML (Workflows, Exchange)

- Analyze, formulate, proposed, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables

- Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

1. Provide professional services to Murex clients:

o Provide services in the domain of system integration, business intelligence and data flows through the full lifecycle of the MX.3: requirements analysis, configuration build, installation, training, upgrade, and production support.

o Professionally interact with Murex colleagues and clients.

2. Build, test, and provide support to clients on MX.3 integration modules.

o Contribute to project implementations

 Participate in design, build, and test phases sometimes remotely and other times at the client site as needed.

 Develop trade workflows and interfaces to set up communication between external platforms and murex to receive trade and other data feeds, process them, save into the system, and send acknowledgement. Use a combination of MXMLExchange, MXopenconnect, Murex APIs, and Datamart to successfully deliver such solutions.

 Contribute to functional documentation of the test cases and use cases by the client.

 Contribute to Design documentation for the Build process of the Product.

 Develop and maintain end-to-end configuration management packages etc. Install, Deploy and test Murex packaged interfaces like MDIT (market data interface tool), Markitwire, BSMT and MarkitCredit to receive live and end-of-day data from external providers like Bloomberg, Reuters, Markit, etc.

o Handle support cases from notification to resolution and validation.

• Participate in the business as usual and project support: follow-up of client open cases through email, CRM portal, phone-calls and on-site visits

• Develop an understanding of ongoing activities and manage own deliverables / progress

• Manage bug fixes and enhancements with the Product Team

3. Integrate with various teams to deliver the right solution to client.

o Work with S4C stream leads, Front-Office, Back-Office, or Risk teams to understand requirements and develop solutions for the client.

o Work with the Product division team to provide them timely details on defects - how to reproduce the issue, project/client constraints, and how to validate the fix.

o Follow up with the S4C stream leads, the Project Manager, and other teams to meet deadlines and regular meetings to make sure the delivery is on time.

4. Work with technologies including SQL, Unix, and Murex proprietary standards like Murex Scripting Language (MSL), XMLF, etc. for client solutions.

o Use SQL for end-of-day report generation, STP (straight through processing) failure issues, P&L evaluation, for analyzing issues in trade feed and status Etc.

o Java programming skills are not essential but are a plus.

o Various Murex proprietary languages and formats: Data Query Language for querying in various screens in MX.3, MSL (Murex Scripting Language) for pre-trade logic, XMLF for post-trade flow processing, MxML in various contexts, etc.

o Create shell/python scripts for automation of day-to-day manual activities.

Understand requirements, analyze the problem areas of the current system and behavior of pre- trade and post-trade workflow, and integration points.

Must:

- SQL; XML; MxML; UNIX; Scripting languages

title: Senior Back-End Engineer (PHP, Node.js, OR Python)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Back-End Engineer with 5+ years of experience. The role focuses on designing and building the secure, scalable API and service integrations that connect SaaS products, data warehouse, and embedded analytics ecosystem.

This role acts as the bridge between the application stack and the data platform, ensuring that analytics, reporting, and automation capabilities are seamlessly exposed to both internal systems and customer-facing applications.

The ideal candidate is a backend engineer experienced with modern frameworks (PHP, Node.js, or Python), API design, multi-tenant authentication (Auth0/SSO), and data service abstractions. They combine strong engineering fundamentals with a deep appreciation for performance, security, and maintainability.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement RESTful and GraphQL APIs that expose warehouse and reporting data to SaaS applications and third-party systems
  • Develop scalable, tenant-aware service layers that abstract complex Redshift or Snowflake queries behind stable, versioned interfaces
  • Build secure integrations between the SaaS application and analytics systems (QuickSight embedding, SSO/role propagation, etc.)
  • Ensure multi-tenant context propagation and data isolation across all API endpoints
  • Work with the Data Platform and Analytics teams to define reusable data-access abstractions
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform Architect to design backend patterns supporting large-scale, automated reporting workloads
  • Implement caching, pagination, and batching strategies for high-volume, concurrent
  • analytics requests
  • Monitor API latency and database query efficiency, applying indexing and optimization
  • where necessary
  • Contribute to system design documentation, endpoint versioning, and architecture diagrams
  • Integrate SSO and identity management (Auth0, Cognito, or OIDC) into all service endpoints
  • Enforce least-privilege data access and row-level security (RLS) through token or role propagation
  • Ensure compliance with PII and data governance policies, encryption standards, and audit logging
  • Collaborate with InfoSec and Compliance teams to perform code reviews and security assessments
  • Work with DevOps to deploy and scale backend services via Docker, ECS, or EKS pipelines
  • Implement CI/CD automation for service deployment, schema migrations, and integration tests
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code definitions (Terraform or CloudFormation)
  • Support observability and monitoring via CloudWatch, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry
  • Partner with Analytics Engineers and Data Platform teams to ensure APIs align with data contracts and warehouse schemas
  • Collaborate with Product Managers to define API requirements and roadmap priorities
  • Participate in technical design reviews, security audits, and postmortems
  • Continuously improve service performance, reliability, and developer experience

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of backend or integration engineering experience in a modern web stack
  • Proficiency in PHP (Laminas, Symfony, Laravel), Node.js, or Python for backend service development
  • Experience designing and maintaining RESTful and GraphQL APIs at scale
  • Hands-on experience integrating data warehouse APIs (Redshift, Snowflake) or analytics services (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Solid understanding of multi-tenant authentication and authorization (SSO, OAuth2, OpenID Connect)
  • Familiarity with AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, and CloudFormation
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and data-access patterns, including query optimization and caching
  • Proven experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and API observability

Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some type of technical engineering
  • Experience with embedded analytics frameworks (AWS QuickSight Embedding SDK, Looker Embed, etc.)
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architectures (tenant isolation, provisioning, and lifecycle automation)
  • Knowledge of GraphQL federation, caching layers (Redis), and event-driven designs
  • Experience in data-driven SaaS products (hospitality, property management, or fintech a plus)
  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, and API auditing practices

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

  • Controle de condicionantes de Licenças de Operação, Outorgas e demais Autorizações Ambientais;
  • Planejamento e Controle de Monitoramentos Ambientais (solo, águas subterrâneas, águas superficiais, efluentes industriais, emissões atmosféricas e qualidade do ar);
  • Tabulação, análise e interpretação de dados de monitoramentos ambientais;
  • Inspeções ambientais em área industrial e agrícola, visando identificação e mitigação de impactos ambientais;

Nossa Empresa

Somos a maior produtora de óleo sustentável da América Latina, reconhecida em todo o mundo pela qualidade superior de nossos produtos e processos, e pelo compromisso com o meio ambiente e as pessoas. Geramos cerca de 5mil empregos diretos e desenvolvemos projetos socioambientais que impactam direta e indiretamente na vida de todos.

Temos operações no Pará e em São Paulo. Nossos plantios e fábricas de extração ficam situados em Tailândia/PA, onde iniciamos nossa trajetória em 1982. Também possuíamos modernas refinarias nas cidades de Belém/PA e Limeira/SP. Especificamente, na unidade de Limeira, temos uma refinaria multióleos, com equipamentos de última geração e um Centro de Inovação pronto para atender às indústrias de panificação, sorvetes, confeitaria, food service, lácteos, cosméticos e produtos não alimentícios (químicos e oleoquímicos).

Mais do que desenvolver produtos de qualidade, nosso objetivo é cooperar para um mundo melhor. Tanto que dos nossos 107 mil hectares de terra, destinamos 64 mil a áreas de reservas florestais preservadas e monitoradas, com riquíssima biodiversidade. Em Tailândia/PA, mantemos agrovilas com completa infraestrutura para nossos colaboradores, com escola, clubes e academia.

description:

title: Business Head - LATAM
description:
Are you passionate about making your customers feel like they've just won the jackpot?

  • You'll maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, and participating in professional societies.

What We're Looking For

  • 15+ years of relevant sales and customer success experience, with extensive knowledge of scaling a geography and practices, and the ability to coach others.
  • Experience managing a high-performance sales and customer success team in the LATAM region.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills; you can use data and metrics to back up assumptions, recommendations, and actions.
  • A proven ability to influence cross-functional teams.
  • Strengths in problem-solving and issue-resolution, the ability to work in a deadline-driven environment, attention to detail, and the ability to multitask.
  • Strong leadership and team-building skills.

Why Netcore?

Being first is in our nature. Netcore Cloud is the first and leading AI/ML-powered customer engagement and experience platform (CEE) that helps B2C brands increase engagement, conversions, revenue, and retention. Our cutting-edge SaaS products enable personalized engageme1nt throughout the entire customer journey and build amazing digital experiences for businesses of all sizes.

Our CEE platform includes six products: Customer Engagement, Email, Personalization, Product Experience, Customer Data Platform (CDP), and Raman —our AI engine.

Netcore has a perfect combination of experience and an agile mindset. We currently work with more than 5,000 enterprise brands across 18 countries and serve over 70% of the Unicorns in India, making us a top-rated customer engagement and experience platform.

Headquartered in Mumbai, we have global offices in 10 countries, including the United States and Germany. Being certified as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years only reinforces Netcore’s principle of being a people-centric company—where you are not just an employee but a family member.

A career at Netcore is more than just a job—it’s an opportunity to shape the future. For more information, please visit netcorecloud.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

What's in It for You?

  • Immense growth, continuous learning, and connections with top-notch brands.
  • Work with some of the most innovative minds.
  • Bring in the biggest revenue deals for the organization.
  • Think and act like a CEO when acquiring large accounts.
  • An opportunity to explore your entrepreneurial mindset.
  • An open culture that will activate your creative spark.

title: Product Owner (P.O.)
description:
Buscamos um Product Owner (PO) apaixonado por tecnologia e focado no cliente para liderar a visão e a estratégia de nosso produto. O PO atuará como a ponte entre os stakeholders (clientes, executivos e vendas) e a equipe de desenvolvimento (squad), garantindo que as entregas agreguem o máximo de valor ao negócio e ao usuário final.

Principais Responsabilidades:

• Gestão do Backlog: Ser o único responsável por gerenciar, priorizar e refinar o Product Backlog, garantindo que os itens sejam claros, transparentes e compreendidos pela equipe;

• Definição da Visão e Estratégia: Definir a visão do produto e o roadmap de curto e longo prazo, comunicando a direção e o propósito do produto para todos os envolvidos;

• Representação do Cliente: Entender profundamente as necessidades, dores e o valor do negócio para o cliente, traduzindo-os em histórias de usuário (User Stories) e critérios de aceitação;

• Tomada de Decisão: Decidir o que deve ser construído, em qual ordem, e aceitar ou rejeitar os resultados do trabalho realizado pela equipe de desenvolvimento em cada Sprint;

• Engajamento de Stakeholders: Atuar como o principal ponto de contato, coletando feedback contínuo e alinhando as expectativas entre as áreas de negócio e a equipe técnica;

• Monitoramento de Métricas: Definir e acompanhar as principais métricas de sucesso do produto (KPIs), utilizando dados para guiar a priorização e validar o valor das funcionalidades entregues;

• Colaboração Ágil: Participar ativamente das cerimônias Scrum (planejamento, review e daily) e colaborar diariamente com o Scrum Master e os desenvolvedores.

Requisitos Essenciais:

• Experiência Comprovada: Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência atuando como Product Owner ou Business Analyst em times de desenvolvimento de software;

• Mentalidade Ágil: Sólido entendimento e prática das metodologias e frameworks ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban);

• Gestão de Backlog: Experiência prática na criação e refinamento de User Stories, épicos e critérios de aceitação;

• Comunicação: Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de negociar e influenciar diferentes níveis de stakeholders;

• Ferramentas: Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de backlog (ex: Jira, Trello, Azure DevOps).

Habilidades e Conhecimentos Desejáveis:

• Certificação CSPO (Certified Scrum Product Owner) ou PSPO (Professional Scrum Product Owner);

• Experiência com UX/UI e testes de usabilidade;

• Conhecimento em técnicas de mapeamento e priorização (ex: MoSCoW, RICE, Kano).

O que oferecemos:

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado (contrato PJ);
  • Recesso anual remunerado.

description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A PizzattoLog é referência em transporte rodoviário e está iniciando um projeto estratégico para evoluir a programação logística e fortalecer a eficiência operacional. Buscamos Doutor(a) com perfil analítico e visão aplicada para conhecer o projeto e contribuir em um desafio real do setor, com atuação próxima da operação e foco em melhorias estruturantes. Se você quer gerar impacto direto no dia a dia da empresa e transformar conhecimento científico em solução prática, venha conhecer essa oportunidade com a PizzattoLog.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutor em Logística, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia de Transportes, Administração ou áreas afins

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Programação perfeita: atrelar carga ideal à disponibilidade de veículo em tempo real

Principais Atividades:

  • Mapear o fluxo atual de programação logística, identificando falhas e lacunas.
  • Realizar revisão bibliográfica e análise comparativa com modelos logísticos de referência.
  • Conduzir pesquisa aplicada com dados reais da empresa.
  • Construir, testar e ajustar um modelo de decisão logística baseado em critérios técnicos.
  • Implantar o modelo junto à equipe operacional e acompanhar os indicadores de desempenho.
  • Registrar os resultados e produzir documentação técnica e científica.

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Análise de processos logísticos;
  • Modelagem decisória;
  • Pesquisa aplicada;
  • Conhecimento em Gestão de projetos;
  • Power BI;
  • Projetos com foco em IA;
  • Excel;
  • Análise estatística;
  • Lean Logistics;
  • Revisão bibliográfica;
  • BPMN;

title: Americas HR Lead
description:
About the role:

As Americas HR Lead (North America and LATAM) you will partner with the respective leaders to develop people strategy that is aligned to both the business and the Versuni People strategy.

To accomplish this, you will facilitate and champion adoption of annual People programs including performance management, succession planning, talent assessment, workforce planning in addition to targeted programs that you create for your business groups that help them achieve and exceed their business strategy.

You will also consult to leadership on organizational design and structure, serve as change leader and management coaching. You will build trusted adviser relationships across your organization and be the point of contact for strategic consultation for the functional areas: employee relations, performance management, on-boarding, policy implementation, and employment law compliance.

The impact you’ll make

  • Shapes and drives talent management programs that are aligned with the overall People strategy while targeting the specific talent needs of the market/functions. Leads the building the talent pipeline for future leaders, manages succession management process and follow-on action planning for the region Americas, covering Sales & Marketing as well as Operations ( Supply Chain, Manufacturing).
  • Lead the quarterly workforce planning (WP) process in collaboration with internal stakeholders ranging from the business Total FTE base (400 FTE).
  • Act as a driver for strategic support on all HR-related initiatives and operational efficiencies and participate/lead projects or process improvement initiatives. Serve as change leader/coach to ensure support for implementation occurs.
  • Deliver high quality, timely and cost-effective people services to the business/market/function.
  • Responsible for building HR capability that embodies our culture across the region.
  • Represents the region in the HR leadership team.
  • Ensure the country HR teams are organized consistently, optimized and have the capability to execute the business, market, function and people strategy within the regional HR teams.
  • Coach, develop and manage the performance and build the capability of the HR talent in your team (5 director reports).
  • Manage the budget of the region in partnership with the COEs.
  • Provide regional input/ feedback into the design of global policies and programs; highlight specific regional requirements to the COEs; deploy within the region.
  • In the lead with labor authorities, Trade Unions and Works Councils supported by local HRM where relevant.
  • Proactively analyze and identify complex people issues, data, and trends to drive change. Recommend appropriate actions.
  • Perform organizational effectiveness analysis and utilize that data to drive change.
  • Ability to communicate with conviction, clearly and effectively with proven listening skills. Ability to lead and facilitate crucial conversations a must.
  • Ability to manage confidential information and act with integrity and discretion.

The skills and knowledge you’ll bring:

  • Expressive HR experience with a blend of business partnering and talent management/development focus, including organizational design/effectiveness, team building, performance management, career coaching and leadership development.
  • Bachelor’s degree required, complemented by an MBA or a related postgraduate degree.
  • Global experience desired; Consumer products industry highly preferred but not required.
  • Strong organization, planning and project management skills; ability to prioritize tasks for both self and team to meet business requirements and deadlines.
  • Full professional proficiency in English is required.
  • Proficiency in Spanish will be considered a differential.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to present ideas and suggestions clearly and effectively.

What we'll give you in return:

  • Salary: Competitive with the market, granted in accordance with local company procedures.
  • Annual Bonus: Target of 26.25% of annual base salary, depending on individual performance, company results, and internal policies.
  • Health Plan: Sulamerica Nacional (Apartment), effective immediately upon admission, with the possibility of including dependents + right to 1 Annual CheckUp (Executive level) at Fleury SP.
  • Dental Plan: Odontoprev.
  • Pharmaceutical Plan: e-Pharma.
  • Wellness Program: Wellhub.
  • Company Car: A company vehicle will be provided as a work tool. The car model will be aligned with your corporate grade and internal company policies.
  • Monthly Fuel Allowance: Accumulative.
  • Telephony Allowance: Monthly allowance for contracting and maintaining voice/data packages as a work tool, according to your scope of activity and current internal policy values.
  • Mobile Buy Allowance: One-time allowance to cover the cost of purchasing a mobile phone.
  • Private Pension Plan: Versuni will contribute with a 100% match of the amount invested.

Ready to make an impact?

From developing game-changing air fryers to perfecting the art of coffee making, Versuni’s purpose is turning houses into homes — and we’re calling on your talent to bring it to life. Join our global team of 6,000+ passionate individuals, work with world-class brands, and shape the future of home living.

We’re ready for you — are you ready for us?

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Remote)
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer

We are looking for a highly skilled DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, maintaining, and improving our infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, observability stack, and platform operations. You will work closely with development, security, and operations teams to ensure reliable delivery, stability, and scalability of our systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI.
  • Manage and evolve our GitOps workflows using FluxCD for Kubernetes deployments.
  • Maintain and enhance our Kubernetes clusters, ensuring reliability, security and scalability.
  • Develop automation tools and services using Python.
  • Manage and support a wide range of open-source services.
  • Administer and secure secrets management using HashiCorp Vault.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimise platform performance and reliability.
  • Work across teams to enhance observability, logging, and monitoring frameworks.
  • Manage and maintain Linux-based environments and infrastructure.
  • Perform basic network troubleshooting and support connectivity-related issues.
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code practices and automation-first culture.

Core Technical Skills

  • Proven track record with GitLab CI for CI/CD pipeline creation and maintenance.
  • Hands-on experience with GitOps tooling, ideally FluxCD.
  • Solid understanding and operational experience with Kubernetes.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux administration and troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on Scripting experience with Python.
  • Experience with open-source services such as, Elastic stack, Prometheus & Alertmanager, Fluentd, Kafka, Consul.
  • Experience with Hashicorp Vault (policies, secrets engines, authentication methods).
  • Experience with Docker/Kubernetes and container lifecycle management.
  • Ability to troubleshoot network connectivity issues (DNS, routing, firewall basics, TCP/IP) would be a positive.

title: Especialista em IOT
description:

No Brasil, estamos presentes em mais de 4.600, somando mais de 83 milhões de clientes. Liderando no saldo de portabilidade em 2022, com 1,2 milhões de linhas portadas, há mais de 5 anos.

Também temos um ambiente de conexão entre nossos negócios e startups, que é o nosso hub de inovação, beOn Claro, e desenvolvemos projetos focados na sustentabilidade, como o programa de Energia Limpa, que já contempla mais de 60% das antenas da Claro com energia renovável.

É claro que, para fazer tudo isso acontecer, a gente tem um grande time!

Trabalhamos em um ambiente dinâmico e que unem as nossas Pessoas ao propósito único que é “Conectar para uma vida mais divertida e produtiva”.

E aí, deu match? Vem pra Claro construir o novo com a gente!

  • Demonstra compromisso permanente em aprender, ensinar e desenvolver, contribuindo para um ambiente descontraído, respeitoso e colaborativo, incentivando a diversidade;
  • É flexível para se desprender de paradigmas e modelos mentais existentes. Busca soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis, para criar vantagens competitivas para o negócio, equilibrando os interesses econômicos, ambientais e sociais.

Pré-requisitos (eliminatórios):

E por que a escolher a Claro?

Na Claro, pessoas é um dos nossos valores. Com este pensamento, investimos sempre no cuidado com a saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida dos nossos colaboradores!

Para que você tenha a melhor experiência em sua jornada com a gente, oferecemos um atraente pacote de benefícios. Veja só:

No Daycoval, entendemos que cuidar de nossos colaboradores é essencial para promover um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo. title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️

About Foundey

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.

Requirements

  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.

Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

How to Apply

If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Sous Chef Corporativo Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento
description:
A Bold Hospitality Company é a holding responsável pelas marcas Outback, Abbraccio e Aussie no Brasil. Temos 27 anos de experiência e reconhecimento, mas a energia renovada de quem começou sua jornada: no final de 2024, nos tornamos uma empresa nacional, que nasceu da união de dois Sócios - Vinci Compass e Bloomin’ Brands Inc.

O Outback, que é a nossa maior e mais conhecida operação, conta com 187 restaurantes no país. Já o Abbraccio, restaurante com temática italiana, tem 17 restaurantes físicos; e o Aussie, voltado para proteína de frango, conta com dois restaurantes físicos - um no Shopping Eldorado, em SP, e um no New York, na Barra da Tijuca - RJ, além da operação no delivery.

A Bold Hospitality Company carrega sua bússola no nome: a hospitalidade. Para nós, é super importante que as pessoas se sintam bem recebidas, acolhidas e que tenham uma experiência positiva conosco em todos os aspectos.

Quais serão as atividades?

Atuar no desenvolvimento de produtos, equipamentos e melhorias operacionais na área de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento, criando receitas, testando e apoiando na validação de equipamentos, revisando receitas, testando produtos substitutos e ajudando nas entregas dos projetos da área.

Quais as principais responsabilidades?

  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento de novas receitas e adaptações/revisões de receitas existentes;
  • Manter os sistemas de receitas e etiquetas atualizados;
  • Realizar compras de insumos para o departamento e prestação de contas de ingredientes utilizados;
  • Desenvolver receitas baseadas em briefings, tendências e demandas internas de produtos;
  • Registrar as receitas desenvolvidas por escrito, incluindo pesagem de ingredientes e rendimento;
  • Participar ativamente dos tastings da área, preparando os produtos, realizando os ajustes e apresentando-os no calendário anual de desenvolvimento;
  • Controlar o estoque de produtos da cozinha experimental, garantindo datas de validades vigentes, PVPS e rastreabilidade de insumos e amostras recebidas;
  • Apoiar as atividades relacionadas à análise e aprovação de novos ingredientes, desenvolvendo e avaliando novos produtos, como: estabelecimento de padrões de qualidade e identidade de produtos, testes de vida de prateleira, desenvolvimento de especificações e procedimentos de manipulação dos alimentos, teste de transporte e operacional;
  • Preparar e participar de comitês de Operações, contribuindo para viabilizar produtos e campanhas dentro das cozinhas das marcas;
  • Realizar o fechamento da cozinha experimental, limpando equipamentos, utensílios e louças, garantindo a organização e as validades dos produtos diariamente;
  • Manter os materiais de receitas e etiquetas atualizados: Recipe Viewer, Sysprep, Build Card Digital, etc
  • Desenvolver conteúdos de apoio para operações para facilitar entendimento de receitas, alergênicos e melhores práticas operacionais;
  • Testar equipamentos atuais e novos para as marcas, redigir relatórios sobre os resultados e contribuir na homologação;

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words  driven ,  team player ,  high performer , etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Business Development Executive with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start.

Our new Business Development Executive will be responsible for our hotel market in the US, Asia and South America. It is an area that we have not focused on in the past, but we have had ad hoc partnerships with various hotels and in various forms, and the time has come to truly focus and succeed in this market. I am looking for a Business Developer who is ready to fully own and grow this market for us. It is a market with huge potential and with great interest in our running tours, and hotels we are currently working with include Mandarin, Hilton, and Marriott. You should be someone who gets super motivated by the fact that there is no straightforward playbook, but instead a lot of building blocks we need to put together to make the perfect Tetris game. When we have this, the world is your oyster, because what works in one hotel will likely be a success in another, and hotel managers talk. And here comes the true superpower of what you are selling. While there are many local running tour providers in each city, Go! Running Tours is the only global player. So when the global hotel chains start eyeing your success with a few of their hotels, you'll be able to enter into a global partnership. And that is really what we are aiming for!

Our new colleague should believe in email outreach. It is our main channel of business generation, and while we don't do stone-cold emailing, we have had success with lukewarm and hot emailing in other markets in the past. You will be responsible for the campaigns and everything that goes with it in terms of crafting messages, building contact lists, and data work. I personally love spreadsheet work and get a kick out of using data extra smart, and if you enjoy that as well, you will thoroughly enjoy this part of the role. It is very important for me that you have the drive and passion to always reach higher. I am not looking for someone to simply do a routine job and be content when we start closing business. I want someone who is continuously energised by doing more, making progress, and growing and scaling. You should be constantly looking for new and better ways of doing things, testing initiatives, and learning new tech/solutions. We are counting on you to make this a global success (the first of its kind)! Drive and diligence are superpowers in this role!

But it is not all rosy. It can be a challenge for hotels to prioritise the implementation of Go! Running Tours into their services. It is frustrating when we are just about to sign a contract and then our contact moves jobs

title: Clinical Research Associate II (Cell Therapy)
description:
Clinical Research Associate II (Cell Therapy)

Greater Sao Paulo Area / Hybrid

Greater Rio de Janeiro Area / Hybrid

Our 3 Core Values

• Intelligence

• Integrity

• Initiative

Our mission is to harness the immune system through innovative cell therapies and other modalities to deliver widely accessible cures. Patients are waiting!

What You'll Do

The Clinical Research Associate (CRA) II will be the primary liaison between the Investigator sites and Nexcella, responsible for overall site conduct and establishing important relationships with key site personnel. The CRA will perform key job functions in accordance with ICH Good Clinical Practice (ICH GCP), FDA regulations, Nexcella SOPs and work practices while supporting the organizational mission to advance the development of promising oncology therapies and technologies to benefit patients. CRAs are expected to work in a hands-on, highly visible and autonomous role. CRAs must have the ability to be flexible and represent Nexcella in a positive and professional manner while collaborating across all levels with the clinical teams and Sponsors/vendors.

Responsibilities :

• Perform site selection, initiation, monitoring, and close-out visits of investigational sites for the Nexcella portfolio of clinical trials.

• Manage the progress of assigned sites by tracking patient recruitment and enrollment, CRF completion and submission, source data verification, data collection, and data query generation and resolution.

• Conduct monitoring activities, including, but not limited to the following:

o Ensuring PI oversight of all trial activities

o Source data review and verification with EDC fields

o Essential documentation review and reconciliation

o Investigational Product (IP) management and accountability

o Lab/kit supply management

• Develop collaborative relationships with investigative sites and personnel.

• Maintain communication with sites through frequent contact to ensure site compliance, adequate enrollment, and understanding of study requirements.

• Write and submit complete and accurate visit letters and reports of investigational site findings and update applicable CTMS.

• Escalates observed deficiencies, issues, and corrective and preventative action plans as appropriate.

• Participate in audit preparations and follow-up, as needed.

• Review and address protocol deviations, data quality issues, and identify process improvements for assigned sites.

• Be a collaborative member of the study team: provide insight, updates, and strategies to improve processes.

• Ability to think critically while prioritizing tasks in an efficient manner to meet study deliverables.

• Contribute to CRF development and perform User Access Testing, as requested.

• Assist with other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

Quem você é:

Você alcança resultados e é consistentemente reconhecido como um dos melhores desempenhos. Você é decisivo e toma decisões de alta qualidade, mesmo quando baseadas em informações incompletas ou diante da incerteza. Você equilibra seus próprios interesses com os interesses dos outros. Você incentiva a expressão aberta de ideias e opiniões diversas.

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

description:

The Client Service Analyst oversees client care by supporting the Sao Paulo client care service team, managing phone calls, e-mails. This professional also deliver an exceptional after-sales experience for our clientele. This position is temporary for 6 months located close to Campo Belo.

title: Gerente administrativo e financeiro
description:
Summary

We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to partner with the Managing Director and the market team to deliver the business plan and support operational execution. This is a managerial role focused on leadership, planning and process improvement, with occasional hands-on operational tasks.

Key responsibilities

Financial and operational leadership

• Act as a trusted business partner to the Managing Director and the wider market team to deliver budget and strategy.

• Own the annual budget, periodic reforecasts and the monthly forward-looking risks & opportunities view, and drive commercial action plans where required.

• Break the business plan and budget into measurable building blocks and KPIs, ensure they are tracked by the FP&A team and by functional partners, and lead corrective actions when performance deviates from target.

• Track return on key investments, including capex for new sales initiatives, and provide actionable analysis to improve outcomes.

• Provide occasional hands-on operational support at month-end to ensure accurate and timely close (see operational tasks below).

Hands-on operational support

• Perform or assist with select month-end journal entries and accruals to support timely close.

• Reconcile key balance sheet accounts and resolve reconciling items when needed.

• Support billing or cash collection tasks in peak periods to ensure targets are met.

• Coordinate with shared services or external teams to clear blockers that would delay reporting.

Finance team leadership

• Build and develop a high-performing finance function aligned to company strategy.

• Line-manage and mentor key direct reports (for example Financial Control, FP&A, Billing and Cash Collection), ensuring the right people are in the right roles.

• Lead recruitment and onboarding of new finance talent as the business grows to support delivery of the plan.

• Foster collaboration between finance and commercial teams to embed financial discipline across the market.

Process leadership

• Provide market leadership on ERP implementation and realise business benefits from new systems.

• Identify and prioritise process improvements across the business (for example debtor management) and drive execution to close the gaps.

• Work with the Group finance community to implement best practices and share learnings that other markets can adopt.

Reporting and compliance

• Ensure accurate and timely monthly and annual reporting that meets Group and third-party obligations and that tracks progress against business goals and KPIs.

• Plan and oversee the annual audit and tax filings, working with the Group tax and control teams to optimise outcomes.

• Support wider reporting requirements such as CSRD and other regulatory or sustainability disclosures as required.

Liquidity and cash management

• Drive delivery against cash targets, ensuring profit is converted into cash.

• Assign ownership and targets for each element of working capital, and drive process improvements where necessary.

• Maintain a 13-week cash flow forecast and a budgeted liquidity plan.

• Coordinate with Group to repatriate cash to the parent company in line with the plan.

Project leadership

• Lead ad-hoc strategic projects, including business cases for commercial opportunities and support for acquisitions or integrations as they arise.

• Provide commercial and financial analysis to support decision making and monitor project outcomes.

Desired experience and skills

• Proven finance manager experience in a commercial environment, ideally with exposure to FP&A, financial control and cash management.

• Strong analytical skills and experience converting financial insight into commercial action.

• Experience leading finance teams and developing talent.

• Comfortable working with ERP systems and driving process improvements.

• Hands-on month-end close experience and a pragmatic approach to resolving operational issues.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Head of Operations (Physical Expansion & Product Lineup)

São Paulo (base) | Frequent travel across Brazil

PJ | Full-time

About Pagô

Pagô is evolving.

We are moving beyond a purely digital model to build a field-driven financial operation , with physical points of presence embedded in the real Brazilian economy.

These locations will not only operate Pagô’s core products — they will also serve as distribution hubs for a broader financial product lineup , built in partnership with external providers.

This role exists because physical execution, product mix, and partnerships must be built together .

The Role

We are looking for a COO with a CEO mindset to design, build, and run Pagô’s physical operations , end to end.

This includes:

  • Building the physical operation
  • Defining what products are offered in each location
  • Structuring and managing relationships with financial product providers

You will take Pagô from strategy to the ground — location by location.

This is a builder role , not a maintenance role.

What You Will Build

  • Pagô’s physical operational model
  • A scalable store-level product lineup (payments, credit, and partner products)
  • Strategic relationships with financial product providers
  • On-the-ground presence in selected cities (especially in the Brazilian interior)
  • Teams, routines, and processes that function in real environments
  • A repeatable playbook for physical expansion

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement Pagô’s physical operations strategy
  • Identify, evaluate, and support the selection of new operational locations
  • Lead the setup of physical points of presence (from zero to running)
  • Define the product lineup offered in each physical location , aligned with local demand
  • Build and manage relationships with financial product providers and partners
  • Negotiate commercial terms, distribution models, and operational flows with providers
  • Ensure products are properly integrated into day-to-day operations
  • Hire, train, and manage local teams
  • Define operational processes that work in the field
  • Be present where the operation happens: customers, partners, local ecosystems
  • Ensure operational consistency while scaling across locations
  • Act as the main execution leader for physical expansion
  • Work closely with product, credit, and risk teams
  • Report directly to the founder with high autonomy

Who We’re Looking For

This role is for top-tier operators with commercial and product judgment .

You are someone who:

  • Thrives in building operations from scratch
  • Understands how product, distribution, and operations connect
  • Is energized by being in the field, not behind a desk
  • Has strong execution discipline and commercial instincts
  • Is highly organized and ownership-driven
  • Is comfortable making decisions with incomplete information
  • Has full flexibility for travel and on-site work
  • Leads by presence and example

Experience with financial products (payments, credit, banking, fintech, or regulated financial operations) and/or building distribution partnerships is a strong plus .

Non-Negotiables

  • High mobility and availability for field work
  • Hands-on leadership style
  • Comfort with ambiguity and responsibility
  • Strong bias toward execution over discussion

What This Is Not

  • Not a corporate COO role
  • Not a strategy-only position
  • Not a remote or desk-only job
  • Not a role for people who avoid operational friction

Compensation

  • Fixed compensation (PJ)
  • Performance-based bonus tied to:
  • Store rollout
  • Product lineup execution
  • Provider partnerships
  • Operational performance
  • Long-term upside aligned with impact

Why This Role Matters

Pagô believes that real financial infrastructure is built on the ground , close to businesses and their ecosystems.

This role sits at the intersection of:

operations × product × distribution .

If you want to build physical operations, define what gets sold, and decide how financial products reach the field , this role was designed for you.

Interested? Send a DM or apply directly.

Rodou, girou, Pagô. ⚡

title: Dean of Students - Upper Grades
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

A Dean is a leader who supports students' wellbeing and partners with colleagues across Avenues and with students’ families to support each student to thrive. Deans build powerful, lasting relationships with students and nurture their development and wellbeing. Deans, associate division heads, and teachers work together closely to make the secondary experience a rewarding one for each student. The dean of student life for upper grades will coordinate student life across the upper grades and nurture a warm and welcoming community experience for students and families.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Nurture students' growth, development, and community experience

  • Develop strong, ongoing relationships with parents and students
  • Monitor and guide upper grade students' academic progress and social and emotional well-being.
  • Uphold high standards of personal conduct by students
  • Create programming and supports for new upper grades students and families, ensuring a smooth transition to Avenues
  • Create programming and supports for our international student community
  • Lead community meetings for upper grades with a focus on our community values and community-building
  • Plan and lead community-wide events for upper grades students, in close collaboration with the operations team.
  • Collaborate with Student Success Team for students who need more intensive support with academics, social/emotional skills, attendance, or physical health issues
  • Track attendance and lead interventions for students
  • Lead any responses to escalated disciplinary cases
  • Support administration of standardized testing for upper grades

title: Product Designer
description:
About the Company

Hi, we’re Actabl. We’re providing better solutions for hotel companies as the world around us evolves and changes related to using technology, finding labor, and maximizing profits. Our mission is to empower the people that power hospitality. We give hoteliers actionable insights to know what to do, the tools to do it, and the visibility to know it worked. We bring together powerful hospitality tech solutions to maximize profits for more than 10,000 properties in hospitality markets around the world.

Our Valued Behaviors

  • Start with People: We are in the hospitality business and hospitality starts with people. This impacts both our being and our doing.
  • Being: We are responsible for building relationships, earning trust, and having fun. These things are fundamental to hospitality.
  • Doing: We will succeed if we start with great people working as one team. Empower others, speak the truth with care, and go together.
  • Demand Integrity: Be trustworthy, be ethical, and be consistent whether someone is watching or not. Demand integrity of yourself and others to build the fabric of a high-integrity organization.
  • Delight the Customer: We aim to delight our customers in the same way our customers aim to delight their guests. The question is not if completed a process or hit a metric, the question is whether or not the customer is delighted.
  • Champion Innovation: We compete in the game of change and win through innovation. Think big and then think bigger when it comes to the innovation required to tackle the problems our customers face daily.
  • Make it Happen: We show up prepared, care about the details, and follow through. Don't get distracted. Don't stop at blockers. Don't make excuses. Find a way and drive until it is done.

About Actabl's Product Design Team

We redefine expectations

We treat SaaS with the same passion and craft you’d expect from world-class consumer products. Our mission is to redefine what hospitality teams can expect from their tools by delivering thoughtful, high-quality experiences and pushing the product forward step by step, with real impact.

Bellhop Design System

Our young design system is called Bellhop because it was inspired by the essence of hospitality. It's a scalable and cohesive system made to empower people who power hospitality. Check out .

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end design across features and flows, from discovery to delivery.
  • Collaborate with PMs and engineers to shape problem spaces, define requirements, and validate solutions.
  • Design intuitive, scalable interfaces for enterprise SaaS products with heavy use of dashboards, complex data tables, and operational workflows .
  • Run user interviews, synthesize insights, and convert them into actionable design decisions.
  • Produce high-quality UI/UX deliverables: journeys, wireframes, flows, high-fidelity screens, prototypes, tables, dashboards, etc.
  • Work closely with our design system team to maintain consistency and push our standards forward.
  • Advocate for user experience and influence decision-making across cross-functional teams.
  • Incorporate AI tools, Vibe Coding, and rapid prototyping into your process to increase velocity and quality.
  • Understand our products, personas, their journeys, and JTBD.

You as a Product Designer

Ideal Profile

You are not a “by the books” Product Designer and have at least 3 years of experience, strong design craft, and excellent communication skills. You are comfortable with high-density enterprise SaaS interfaces such as dashboards and data grids, and you work confidently with design systems and cross-functional teams.

  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Designer (UX/UI) in tech or SaaS companies.
  • Portuguese and English is mandatory
  • Living in Brazil.
  • Strong product thinking, ability to break down complexity, understand constraints, frame problems, and propose pragmatic solutions.
  • Excellent English communication (major stakeholders are native english speakers)
  • Solid experience designing for enterprise SaaS applications.
  • Comfortable crafting elegant high-density interfaces.
  • Experience working with design systems (tokens, components, libraries).
  • Strong craft with an attention to detail.
  • Portfolio demonstrating clear thinking, strong fundamentals, and high-quality craft.'

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI prototyping tools (e.g., Figma Make, V0, Claude Code).
  • Experience integrating AI into design workflows.
  • Familiarity with hospitality, operational tools, or B2B workflows.

Work Environment:

Location: Full-remote Brasil.

Connectivity: Requires a reliable internet connection and a suitable home office setup.

Equipment: The company provides necessary equipment (laptop, monitor, peripherals).

Travel: Occasional travel may be required. A valid driver's license may be required for travel.

Work Hours: Employees are expected to be available during core business hours to ensure collaboration with team members and stakeholders.

Communication: Regular communication via video calls, chat applications, and email is expected.

title: Gerente e Vendas SAP

Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo?

O que precisa para você se candidatar à vaga?

O que estará disponível para você?

Queremos que você alcance seus objetivos profissionais e pessoais e, por isso, contamos com a Universidade Corporativa, acesso a plataformas online de aprendizado, plataforma de idiomas com mais de 7.500 conteúdos e cerca de 60 cursos divididos por nível, área de atuação, habilidades profissionais e interesses, e até uma plataforma que reúne diversas instituições de ensino, oferecendo descontos exclusivos para profissionais da Deloitte e seus dependentes.

Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com as pessoas, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone. 
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional. 

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others. 

Who you are 

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package 
  • Paid Time Off 
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate’s education, experience, skills and potential.
Hunter Douglas is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

By submitting your application below, you are providing your prior consent to receive SMS messages to notify you of any updates to your application status and to engage in discussion throughout your application process. You can cancel the SMS service at any time. Just text “STOP” to any of our texts to unsubscribe. Message & data rates may apply. Message frequency may vary. If you have any questions regarding privacy, please read our privacy policy, or terms of use

title: Regional Sales Manager - Home Applicance Industry
description:
Need Candidates from Home Appliance Industry.

Core Objective

Responsible for the overall planning, development, and operation of the channel network within the designated region. Through strategy formulation, distributor management, terminal empowerment, and supply chain control, ensure the achievement of regional sales targets and the healthy, efficient development of the channels.

Key Responsibilities & Performance Targets

Regional Network Strategy & Planning

Core Responsibility: Develop and implement the development strategy for network touchpoints in the region.

Performance Target:* Establish clear channel layout plans, effectively receive and decompose regional sales targets, providing a clear network roadmap for business expansion.

Expense & Budget Management

Core Responsibility: Responsible for the formulation and management of regional marketing expenses and distributor policies (e.g., rebates, inventory subsidies, marketing support).

Performance Target: Optimize input-output efficiency under the premise of ensuring partnership stability, achieving precise budget utilization and maximizing Return on Investment (ROI).

Distributor Network Management & Expansion

Core Responsibility: Responsible for the development, relationship maintenance, and daily management of distributor clients within the region.

Performance Target: Maintain the healthy and sound development of the client network, continuously expand effective coverage through channel (penetration), and increase market share.

Terminal Store Operation Empowerment

Core Responsibility: Guide and assist distributors in the standardized operation of terminal stores, including product display, promotional campaign execution, sales personnel training, etc.

Performance Target: Enhance terminal store efficiency in consumer reach, order conversion rate, and average transaction value, driving sales growth at the terminal.

Regional Inventory, Sales & Distribution Management

Core Responsibility: Monitor and manage product procurement, sales, and inventory dynamics at the regional level.

Performance Target: Ensure sufficient product supply at terminals, optimize inventory structure, effectively prevent stockouts or overstock situations, and guarantee smooth supply chain operations.

Management Hierarchy & Collaboration

For Company Strategy: Receive and execute the company's overall channel strategy, ensuring regional network alignment with corporate revenue goals.

For Terminal Market: Empower distributors and terminal stores through a series of operational support actions to directly enhance terminal market performance and consumer experience.

Qualifications

Proficiency in Portuguese, coupled with proficiency in either Chinese or English.

Experience in channel sales (Must - home appliance industry) .

Possession of offline channel resources.
